Class Payment2Selector

public inherited sharing class Payment2Selector

Selector class for Payment2__c object that provides centralized SOQL query methods. Implements the Selector pattern for data access layer with standardized result handling. All methods return Result objects that extend Tools.QueryResult or Tools.QueryAggregateResult.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:

Version:

  • 08/26/2024 - v1.4 - Added countPaymentsByAccount() method to count unassigned payments by account within date range

  • 11/08/2025 - v1.6 - Updated getPaymentsByIntentIds() method to return BillsAssigned__c field
  • 03/19/2026 - v1.7 - Methods countPayments() and countPaymentsByAccount() now returns QueryAggregateResult instead of Tools.QueryAggregateResult
